     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from desloppify.state import StateModel
     6→
     7→
     8→def new_item_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
     9→    """Return finding IDs added in the most recent scan."""
    10→    scan_history = state.get("scan_history", [])
    11→    if not scan_history:
    12→        return set()
    13→    threshold = scan_history[-1].get("timestamp", "")
    14→    if not threshold:
    15→        return set()
    16→    return {
    17→        finding_id
    18→        for finding_id, finding in state.get("findings", {}).items()
    19→        if finding.get("first_seen", "") >= threshold
    20→    }
    21→
    22→
    23→def apply_plan_order(
    24→    items: list[dict],
    25→    plan: dict,
    26→    *,
    27→    include_skipped: bool = False,
    28→    cluster: str | None = None,
    29→    new_ids: set[str] | None = None,
    30→) -> list[dict]:
    31→    """Reorder items according to the living plan."""
    32→    queue_order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    33→    skipped_map: dict = plan.get("skipped", {})
    34→    skipped_ids: set[str] = set(skipped_map.keys())
    35→    overrides: dict = plan.get("overrides", {})
    36→    clusters: dict = plan.get("clusters", {})
    37→    active_cluster = plan.get("active_cluster")
    38→
    39→    by_id: dict[str, dict] = {}
    40→    for item in items:
    41→        by_id[item["id"]] = item
    42→
    43→    for item_id, item in by_id.items():
    44→        override = overrides.get(item_id, {})
    45→        if override.get("description"):
    46→            item["plan_description"] = override["description"]
    47→        if override.get("note"):
    48→            item["plan_note"] = override["note"]
    49→        if override.get("cluster"):
    50→            cluster_name = override["cluster"]
    51→            cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
    52→            item["plan_cluster"] = {
    53→                "name": cluster_name,
    54→                "description": cluster_data.get("description"),
    55→                "total_items": len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", [])),
    56→            }
    57→
    58→    ordered: list[dict] = []
    59→    ordered_ids: set[str] = set()
    60→    for finding_id in queue_order:
    61→        if finding_id in by_id and finding_id not in skipped_ids:
    62→            ordered.append(by_id[finding_id])
    63→            ordered_ids.add(finding_id)
    64→
    65→    skipped_items: list[dict] = []
    66→    remaining_existing: list[dict] = []
    67→    remaining_new: list[dict] = []
    68→    _new = new_ids or set()
    69→    for item in items:
    70→        item_id = item["id"]
    71→        if item_id in ordered_ids:
    72→            continue
    73→        if item_id in skipped_ids:
    74→            skipped_items.append(item)
    75→        elif item_id in _new:
    76→            remaining_new.append(item)
    77→        else:
    78→            remaining_existing.append(item)
    79→
    80→    result = ordered + remaining_existing + remaining_new
    81→
    82→    # Triage stage IDs can appear in queue_order, so plan ordering may
    83→    # scramble their dependency order.  Re-sort just the stage items
    84→    # in-place to restore unblocked-before-blocked invariant.
    85→    stage_entries = [
    86→        (i, item) for i, item in enumerate(result)
    87→        if item.get("kind") == "workflow_stage"
    88→    ]
    89→    if len(stage_entries) > 1:
    90→        sorted_stages = sorted(
    91→            [item for _, item in stage_entries],
    92→            key=lambda it: (
    93→                1 if it.get("is_blocked") else 0,
    94→                int(it.get("stage_index", 0)),
    95→            ),
    96→        )
    97→        for (idx, _), replacement in zip(stage_entries, sorted_stages):
    98→            result[idx] = replacement
    99→
   100→    if include_skipped:
   101→        result = result + skipped_items
   102→
   103→    for position, item in enumerate(result):
   104→        item["queue_position"] = position + 1
   105→        if item["id"] in skipped_ids:
   106→            item["plan_skipped"] = True
   107→            skip_entry = skipped_map.get(item["id"])
   108→            if skip_entry:
   109→                item["plan_skip_kind"] = skip_entry.get("kind", "temporary")
   110→                skip_reason = skip_entry.get("reason")
   111→                if skip_reason:
   112→                    item["plan_skip_reason"] = skip_reason
   113→
   114→    effective_cluster = cluster or active_cluster
   115→    if effective_cluster:
   116→        cluster_data = clusters.get(effective_cluster, {})
   117→        cluster_member_ids = set(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   118→        if cluster_member_ids:
   119→            result = [item for item in result if item["id"] in cluster_member_ids]
   120→    return result

   123→def action_type_for_detector(detector: str) -> str:
   124→    """Look up the action_type for a detector from the registry."""
   125→    try:
   126→        from desloppify.core.registry import DETECTORS
   127→
   128→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   129→        if meta:
   130→            return meta.action_type
   131→    except ImportError as exc:
   132→        _ = exc
   133→    return "manual_fix"
   134→

   136→def _build_cluster_meta(
   137→    cluster_name: str, members: list[dict], cluster_data: dict
   138→) -> dict:
   139→    """Build a cluster meta-item from its member items."""
   140→    detector = members[0].get("detector", "") if members else ""
   141→    action = cluster_data.get("action") or ""
   142→    if "desloppify autofix" in action:
   143→        action_type = "auto_fix"
   144→    elif "desloppify move" in action:
   145→        action_type = "reorganize"
   146→    else:
   147→        action_type = action_type_for_detector(detector)
   148→        if action_type == "auto_fix" and "desloppify autofix" not in action:
   149→            action_type = "refactor"
   150→
   151→    stored_desc = cluster_data.get("description") or ""
   152→    total_in_cluster = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   153→    if stored_desc and total_in_cluster != len(members):
   154→        summary = stored_desc.replace(str(total_in_cluster), str(len(members)))
   155→    else:
   156→        summary = stored_desc or f"{len(members)} findings"
   157→
   158→    primary_command = cluster_data.get("action")
   159→    if not primary_command:
   160→        primary_command = f"desloppify next --cluster {cluster_name} --count 10"
   161→
   162→    estimated_impact = max(
   163→        (m.get("estimated_impact", 0.0) for m in members), default=0.0
   164→    )
   165→
   166→    return {
   167→        "id": cluster_name,
   168→        "kind": "cluster",
   169→        "action_type": action_type,
   170→        "summary": summary,
   171→        "members": members,
   172→        "member_count": len(members),
   173→        "primary_command": primary_command,
   174→        "cluster_name": cluster_name,
   175→        "cluster_auto": True,
   176→        "cluster_optional": bool(cluster_data.get("optional")),
   177→        "confidence": "high",
   178→        "detector": detector,
   179→        "file": "",
   180→        "estimated_impact": estimated_impact,
   181→    }
   182→
   183→
   184→def collapse_clusters(items: list[dict], plan: dict) -> list[dict]:
   185→    """Replace cluster member items with single cluster meta-items.
   186→
   187→    Walks the list in order: the first member of each collapsed cluster is
   188→    replaced with its meta-item, subsequent members are skipped.  This
   189→    preserves the ordering established by sort + plan-order.
   190→    """
   191→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   192→    if not clusters:
   193→        return items
   194→
   195→    fid_to_cluster: dict[str, str] = {}
   196→    for name, cluster in clusters.items():
   197→        if not cluster.get("auto"):
   198→            continue
   199→        for finding_id in cluster.get("finding_ids", []):
   200→            fid_to_cluster[finding_id] = name
   201→
   202→    if not fid_to_cluster:
   203→        return items
   204→
   205→    # Collect members per cluster (preserving encounter order)
   206→    cluster_members: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
   207→    for item in items:
   208→        cname = fid_to_cluster.get(item.get("id", ""))
   209→        if cname:
   210→            cluster_members.setdefault(cname, []).append(item)
   211→
   212→    # Build meta-items only for clusters with 2+ members in the queue
   213→    meta_items: dict[str, dict] = {}
   214→    for cname, members in cluster_members.items():
   215→        if len(members) < 2:
   216→            continue
   217→        meta_items[cname] = _build_cluster_meta(
   218→            cname, members, clusters.get(cname, {})
   219→        )
   220→
   221→    # Walk in order: replace first member of each collapsed cluster
   222→    # with its meta-item, skip subsequent members
   223→    seen_clusters: set[str] = set()
   224→    result: list[dict] = []
   225→    for item in items:
   226→        cname = fid_to_cluster.get(item.get("id", ""))
   227→        if cname and cname in meta_items:
   228→            if cname not in seen_clusters:
   229→                seen_clusters.add(cname)
   230→                result.append(meta_items[cname])
   231→            # skip individual member
   232→        else:
   233→            result.append(item)
   234→    return result
   235→
   236→
   237→__all__ = [
   238→    "apply_plan_order",
   239→    "collapse_clusters",
   240→    "new_item_ids",
   241→]
   242→

1→"""Queue-order enforcement helpers for resolve command flows."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from desloppify.core.output_api import colorize
     6→from desloppify.engine.plan import has_living_plan, load_plan
     7→from desloppify.engine.work_queue import QueueBuildOptions, build_work_queue
     8→
     9→
    10→def _check_queue_order_guard(
    11→    state: dict,
    12→    patterns: list[str],
    13→    status: str,
    14→) -> bool:
    15→    """Warn and block if resolving items not at the front of the plan queue."""
    16→    if status != "fixed":
    17→        return False
    18→    try:
    19→        if not has_living_plan():
    20→            return False
    21→        plan = load_plan()
    22→        queue_order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    23→        if not queue_order:
    24→            return False
    25→
    26→        result = build_work_queue(
    27→            state,
    28→            options=QueueBuildOptions(
    29→                plan=plan,
    30→                count=1,
    31→                collapse_clusters=True,
    32→                include_subjective=True,
    33→            ),
    34→        )
    35→        if not result["items"]:
    36→            return False
    37→
    38→        front_item = result["items"][0]
    39→        front_id = front_item["id"]
    40→
    41→        front_ids: set[str] = set()
    42→        if front_item.get("kind") == "cluster":
    43→            for member in front_item.get("members", []):
    44→                front_ids.add(member["id"])
    45→            front_ids.add(front_id)
    46→        else:
    47→            front_ids.add(front_id)
    48→
    49→        clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
    50→        resolved_ids: set[str] = set()
    51→        for pattern in patterns:
    52→            if pattern in clusters:
    53→                resolved_ids.update(clusters[pattern].get("finding_ids", []))
    54→                resolved_ids.add(pattern)
    55→            else:
    56→                resolved_ids.add(pattern)
    57→
    58→        findings = state.get("findings", {})
    59→        resolved_ids = {
    60→            finding_id
    61→            for finding_id in resolved_ids
    62→            if finding_id in clusters
    63→            or (finding_id in findings and findings[finding_id].get("status") == "open")
    64→        }
    65→        if not resolved_ids:
    66→            return False
    67→
    68→        out_of_order = resolved_ids - front_ids
    69→        for cluster_id in list(out_of_order):
    70→            if cluster_id in clusters:
    71→                alive_members = {
    72→                    finding_id
    73→                    for finding_id in clusters[cluster_id].get("finding_ids", [])
    74→                    if finding_id in findings and findings[finding_id].get("status") == "open"
    75→                }
    76→                if alive_members and alive_members <= front_ids:
    77→                    out_of_order.discard(cluster_id)
    78→        if not out_of_order:
    79→            return False
    80→
    81→        print(colorize("\n  Queue order violation: these items are not next in the plan queue:\n", "yellow"))
    82→        for finding_id in sorted(out_of_order):
    83→            print(f"    {finding_id}")
    84→        print(colorize(f"\n  The current next item is: {front_id}", "dim"))
    85→        print(colorize("  Items must be resolved in plan order. If you need to reprioritize:", "dim"))
    86→        print(colorize("    desloppify plan move <pattern> --position top    # move to front", "dim"))
    87→        print(colorize("    desloppify plan skip <pattern> --reason '...'    # skip for now", "dim"))
    88→        print(colorize("    desloppify next                                  # see what's next\n", "dim"))
    89→        return True
    90→    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
    91→        return False
    92→
    93→
    94→__all__ = ["_check_queue_order_guard"]
    95→

1→"""Preflight guards for subjective review reruns.
     2→
     3→Blocks reruns while backlog remains (objective findings and/or subjective queue
     4→work), unless ``--force-review-rerun`` is set. Also clears stale subjective
     5→markers before a new cycle.
     6→"""
     7→
     8→from __future__ import annotations
     9→
    10→import re
    11→import sys
    12→
    13→from desloppify.core.exception_sets import CommandError
    14→from desloppify.core.output_api import colorize
    15→from desloppify.engine.plan import compute_subjective_visibility
    16→from desloppify.engine.work_queue import QueueBuildOptions, build_work_queue
    17→from desloppify.state import StateModel, save_state
    18→
    19→from .helpers import parse_dimensions
    20→
    21→
    22→def clear_stale_subjective_entries(
    23→    state: StateModel,
    24→    *,
    25→    dimensions: set[str] | None = None,
    26→) -> list[str]:
    27→    """Clear ``needs_review_refresh`` markers from subjective assessments.
    28→
    29→    When *dimensions* is provided, only those dimensions are cleared;
    30→    otherwise all stale dimensions are cleared.
    31→
    32→    Returns the list of dimension keys that were cleared.
    33→    """
    34→    assessments: dict = state.get("subjective_assessments", {})
    35→    cleared: list[str] = []
    36→    for dim_key, assessment in assessments.items():
    37→        if not isinstance(assessment, dict):
    38→            continue
    39→        if dimensions is not None and dim_key not in dimensions:
    40→            continue
    41→        if assessment.get("needs_review_refresh"):
    42→            assessment.pop("needs_review_refresh", None)
    43→            assessment.pop("stale_since", None)
    44→            assessment.pop("refresh_reason", None)
    45→            cleared.append(dim_key)
    46→    return cleared
    47→
    48→
    49→def _scored_dimensions(state: StateModel) -> list[str]:
    50→    """Return dimension keys that already have a nonzero subjective score."""
    51→    assessments: dict = state.get("subjective_assessments", {})
    52→    scored: list[str] = []
    53→    for dim_key, assessment in assessments.items():
    54→        if isinstance(assessment, dict):
    55→            if assessment.get("score", 0):
    56→                scored.append(dim_key)
    57→        elif isinstance(assessment, (int, float)) and assessment:
    58→            scored.append(dim_key)
    59→    return sorted(scored)
    60→
    61→
    62→def _normalize_dimension_key(raw: object) -> str:
    63→    """Normalize a dimension key/name to canonical snake_case."""
    64→    text = str(raw or "").strip().lower().replace(" ", "_")
    65→    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_]+", "_", text).strip("_")
    66→
    67→
    68→def _count_open_subjective_queue_items(
    69→    state: StateModel,
    70→    *,
    71→    dimensions: set[str] | None = None,
    72→    policy=None,
    73→) -> int:
    74→    """Count open synthetic subjective queue items for rerun gating."""
    75→    normalized_dims = (
    76→        {_normalize_dimension_key(dim) for dim in dimensions}
    77→        if dimensions is not None
    78→        else None
    79→    )
    80→    queue = build_work_queue(
    81→        state,
    82→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
    83→            status="open",
    84→            include_subjective=True,
    85→            count=None,
    86→            policy=policy,
    87→        ),
    88→    )
    89→    count = 0
    90→    for item in queue.get("items", []):
    91→        if item.get("kind") != "subjective_dimension":
    92→            continue
    93→        # Stale reruns are not blocking backlog — they ARE the work
    94→        if item.get("stale_review"):
    95→            continue
    96→        if normalized_dims is None:
    97→            count += 1
    98→            continue
    99→        detail = item.get("detail")
   100→        raw_dim = detail.get("dimension", "") if isinstance(detail, dict) else ""
   101→        item_dim = _normalize_dimension_key(raw_dim)
   102→        if item_dim and item_dim in normalized_dims:
   103→            count += 1
   104→    return count
   105→
   106→
   107→def _blocking_scored_dimensions(
   108→    state: StateModel,
   109→    *,
   110→    dimensions: set[str] | None,
   111→    normalized_dimensions: set[str] | None,
   112→) -> list[str]:
   113→    scored_dims = _scored_dimensions(state)
   114→    if dimensions is None:
   115→        return scored_dims
   116→    normalized = normalized_dimensions or set()
   117→    return sorted(
   118→        dim
   119→        for dim in scored_dims
   120→        if _normalize_dimension_key(dim) in normalized
   121→    )
   122→
   123→
   124→def _objective_and_subjective_backlog(
   125→    state: StateModel,
   126→    *,
   127→    blocking_dims: list[str],
   128→) -> tuple[int, int]:
   129→    policy = compute_subjective_visibility(state)
   130→    objective_total = policy.objective_count
   131→    subjective_total = _count_open_subjective_queue_items(
   132→        state,
   133→        dimensions=set(blocking_dims),
   134→        policy=policy,
   135→    )
   136→    return objective_total, subjective_total
   137→
   138→
   139→def _print_backlog_blocked_message(
   140→    *,
   141→    blocking_dims: list[str],
   142→    objective_total: int,
   143→    subjective_total: int,
   144→    dimensions: set[str] | None,
   145→) -> None:
   146→    print(
   147→        colorize(
   148→            "  Blocked: rerun requires drained backlog "
   149→            f"(objective: {objective_total}, subjective: {subjective_total}).",
   150→            "red",
   151→        ),
   152→        file=sys.stderr,
   153→    )
   154→    print(
   155→        colorize(
   156→            f"  Scored dimensions: {', '.join(blocking_dims)}",
   157→            "yellow",
   158→        ),
   159→        file=sys.stderr,
   160→    )
   161→    if objective_total > 0:
   162→        print(
   163→            colorize(
   164→                f"  Open objective finding(s): {objective_total}",
   165→                "yellow",
   166→            ),
   167→            file=sys.stderr,
   168→        )
   169→    if subjective_total > 0:
   170→        print(
   171→            colorize(
   172→                f"  Open subjective queue item(s): {subjective_total}",
   173→                "yellow",
   174→            ),
   175→            file=sys.stderr,
   176→        )
   177→    print("", file=sys.stderr)
   178→    if dimensions is not None:
   179→        unscored = sorted(dimensions - set(blocking_dims))
   180→        if unscored:
   181→            print(
   182→                colorize(
   183→                    f"  Tip: target only unscored dimensions with "
   184→                    f"--dimensions {','.join(unscored)}",
   185→                    "dim",
   186→                ),
   187→                file=sys.stderr,
   188→            )
   189→    print(
   190→        colorize(
   191→            "  Resolve open items first, or override with --force-review-rerun",
   192→            "dim",
   193→        ),
   194→        file=sys.stderr,
   195→    )
   196→
   197→
   198→def review_rerun_preflight(
   199→    state: StateModel,
   200→    args,
   201→    *,
   202→    state_file=None,
   203→    save_fn=save_state,
   204→) -> None:
   205→    """Single entry point: gate check -> clear stale -> save.
   206→
   207→    Exits with code 1 when open backlog exists and ``--force-review-rerun`` is
   208→    not set. On success, clears stale subjective markers for targeted
   209→    dimensions and persists state.
   210→    """
   211→    dimensions = parse_dimensions(args)
   212→    normalized_dimensions = (
   213→        {_normalize_dimension_key(dim) for dim in dimensions}
   214→        if dimensions is not None
   215→        else None
   216→    )
   217→
   218→    # --force-review-rerun bypasses the gate
   219→    if getattr(args, "force_review_rerun", False):
   220→        print(
   221→            colorize(
   222→                "  --force-review-rerun: bypassing rerun backlog checks.",
   223→                "yellow",
   224→            )
   225→        )
   226→    else:
   227→        # Only gate dimensions that are actually targeted by this review run.
   228→        blocking_dims = _blocking_scored_dimensions(
   229→            state,
   230→            dimensions=dimensions,
   231→            normalized_dimensions=normalized_dimensions,
   232→        )
   233→
   234→        # No gate when none of the targeted dimensions have prior scores —
   235→        # this is a first run for these dimensions, not a rerun.
   236→        if blocking_dims:
   237→            objective_total, subjective_total = _objective_and_subjective_backlog(
   238→                state,
   239→                blocking_dims=blocking_dims,
   240→            )
   241→            if objective_total > 0 or subjective_total > 0:
   242→                _print_backlog_blocked_message(
   243→                    blocking_dims=blocking_dims,
   244→                    objective_total=objective_total,
   245→                    subjective_total=subjective_total,
   246→                    dimensions=dimensions,
   247→                )
   248→                raise CommandError(
   249→                    f"rerun blocked: open backlog (objective: {objective_total}, "
   250→                    f"subjective: {subjective_total})",
   251→                    exit_code=1,
   252→                )
   253→
   254→    # Gate passed — clear stale for targeted dims
   255→    cleared = clear_stale_subjective_entries(state, dimensions=dimensions)
   256→    if cleared and state_file:
   257→        save_fn(state, state_file)
   258→        print(
   259→            colorize(
   260→                f"  Cleared stale review markers: {', '.join(sorted(cleared))}",
   261→                "cyan",
   262→            )
   263→        )
   264→

Here is the comprehensive implementation plan.

## Design Plan: Fixing the next/scan Infinite Loop and Related Bugs (#194, #195, #196)

### The Deeper Abstraction That Is Missing

The root cause is not any single miscounted value. The root cause is that **there is no canonical "effective queue scope" concept** -- every caller independently decides whether to pass `scan_path`, whether to consider plan-skipped items, and whether to account for subjective policy. The result is that "how many items are in the queue?" has multiple different answers depending on who asks. This plan introduces a unified resolution layer.

---

### Fix 1: Orphaned Findings -- Auto-Resolve Out-of-Scope Findings

**Decision: auto_resolve_disappeared() should resolve out-of-scope findings when scan_path has narrowed.**

The current code at `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_state/merge_findings.py:79-86` deliberately skips out-of-scope findings with the comment rationale that they belong to a different scan scope. But the effect is that they become zombies: no scan will ever see them again (since the scan_path has moved), and no command will present them to the user (since `next` applies scan_path filtering).

**Approach**: Change `auto_resolve_disappeared()` to resolve (not skip) findings outside the current scan_path, with a distinct resolution note. The key behavioral change:

**File: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_state/merge_findings.py`**

Lines 79-86 currently:
```python
if scan_path and scan_path != ".":
    prefix = scan_path.rstrip("/") + "/"
    if (
        not previous["file"].startswith(prefix)
        and previous["file"] != scan_path
    ):
        skipped_out_of_scope += 1
        continue  # <-- left orphaned forever
```

Change to: Auto-resolve these findings with `status="auto_resolved"` and a note like `"Out of scope — scan_path narrowed to {scan_path}"`. The counter `skipped_out_of_scope` becomes `resolved_out_of_scope`, and the function signature's return tuple adds this count (or repurposes the existing `skipped_out_of_scope` slot).

**Important caveat**: If the user later re-widens scan_path (e.g., back to "."), re-scanning will rediscover the findings and `upsert_findings` will reopen them via the existing reopen logic (lines 180-201). This is correct behavior -- findings are reopened when rediscovered.

**Alternative considered and rejected**: A separate `desloppify cleanup` command. This is worse because it requires user awareness of the problem, and the infinite-loop trap means the user can not even reach a clean state to run such a command.

**Tests needed**: Add a test case in `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/tests` (likely new file or existing merge_findings test) that:
1. Creates findings in `supabase/functions/` and sets `scan_path="src/"`.
2. Calls `auto_resolve_disappeared()` and asserts out-of-scope findings are auto_resolved, not skipped.
3. Verifies the resolution note mentions scan_path.

---

### Fix 2: Consistent Queue Counting via Scan Path Propagation

**Decision: `plan_aware_queue_count()` and `plan_aware_queue_breakdown()` must respect scan_path.**

The core problem is in `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/helpers/queue_progress.py`. Both `plan_aware_queue_count` (line 191) and `plan_aware_queue_breakdown` (line 30) call `build_work_queue` without passing `scan_path`:

```python
# plan_aware_queue_count (line 195)
result = build_work_queue(
    state,
    options=QueueBuildOptions(
        status="open",
        count=None,
        plan=plan,
        collapse_clusters=True,
        include_skipped=False,
        # scan_path is MISSING
    ),
)
```

**Approach**: Add `scan_path` to both functions, defaulting to extracting it from `state.get("scan_path")`.

There are two possible designs:

**Option A (simpler, recommended)**: Always extract `scan_path` from state inside these functions:
```python
def plan_aware_queue_count(state: dict, plan: dict | None = None) -> int:
    result = build_work_queue(
        state,
        options=QueueBuildOptions(
            status="open",
            count=None,
            plan=plan,
            collapse_clusters=True,
            include_skipped=False,
            scan_path=state.get("scan_path"),  # ADD THIS
        ),
    )
    return result["total"]
```

The same change for `plan_aware_queue_breakdown`.

**Option B**: Add a `scan_path` parameter with a sentinel default. Rejected because: all 6 call sites pass `state` which already contains `scan_path` -- there is no case where a caller needs a different scan_path than what is in state.

**Callers affected (all should get consistent results automatically)**:
- `scan_preflight.py:58` -- `plan_aware_queue_count(state, plan)` -- currently counts orphaned findings, will now correctly exclude them.
- `scan_workflow.py:193` -- `plan_aware_queue_count(state, plan)` -- same.
- `plan_nudge.py:20` -- `plan_aware_queue_count(state, plan)` -- same.
- `next.py:157` -- `plan_aware_queue_breakdown(state, plan_data)` -- will now be consistent with `next`'s own queue call (which does pass scan_path).
- `status_cmd.py:188,209` -- `plan_aware_queue_breakdown(state, plan)` -- same.
- `queue_progress.py:303` -- internal `plan_aware_queue_breakdown(state, plan)` -- same.

**Tests**: Update `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/tests/commands/test_scan_preflight.py` to add a test that verifies `plan_aware_queue_count` is called with the state that contains scan_path, and that out-of-scope findings do not inflate the count.

---

### Fix 3: Subjective Policy Must Respect Scan Path and Plan Skips

**Decision: `compute_subjective_visibility()` should filter by scan_path and exclude plan-skipped findings.**

In `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/subjective_policy.py`, lines 100-107:

```python
objective_count = sum(
    1
    for f in findings.values()
    if f.get("status") == "open"
    and f.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
    and not f.get("suppressed")
    and not _is_evidence_only(f)
)
```

This counts ALL open findings globally. But "objective backlog" should mean "objective findings the user is expected to work on" -- not findings they have deliberately skipped, and not findings outside their scan scope.

**Approach**: Add optional `scan_path` and `plan` parameters to `compute_subjective_visibility()`:

```python
def compute_subjective_visibility(
    state: StateModel,
    *,
    target_strict: float = 95.0,
    scan_path: str | None = None,
    plan: dict | None = None,
) -> SubjectiveVisibility:
```

Then filter objective findings:
1. Apply `finding_in_scan_scope()` when `scan_path` is set (import from `desloppify.engine._state.filtering`).
2. Exclude findings whose IDs are in `plan.get("skipped", {})` when `plan` is set.

**Critical design decision**: Skipped items should still count toward `objective_count` if the user has not explicitly set a plan. Skipping only matters when there is an active plan, because the plan represents the user's intentional triage. Without a plan, all findings are "in scope."

**Callers that need updating**:

Should pass `scan_path=resolved_options.scan_path` and `plan=resolved_options.plan` to `compute_subjective_visibility`.
- `review/preflight.py:129`: `policy = compute_subjective_visibility(state)`. Should pass `scan_path=state.get("scan_path")`.
- Any other direct callers of `compute_subjective_visibility` should be audited.

**Tests**: Add tests to `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/tests` that verify:
1. Out-of-scope findings don't count as "objective backlog."
2. Plan-skipped findings don't count as "objective backlog."
3. Without a plan, all in-scope findings count.

**Current state**: After checking the working tree, `detect_signature_variance` is only called in one place in production code: `phase_signature()` in `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/languages/_framework/base/shared_phases.py:425`. The old `sig_variance` smell entries in `phase_smells()` appear to have already been removed (no `sig_variance` or `detect_signature_variance` references in the smells detectors or finding factories).

However, the user reports 32 findings under `signature::*::signature_variance::*` and 32 under `smells::*::sig_variance::*`, which means the orphaned `smells::sig_variance` findings are from a previous scan and were never auto-resolved.

**If the duplicate detection code has already been removed**: The fix is simply Fix 1 (orphan resolution). Once out-of-scope findings are properly auto-resolved, the stale `smells::sig_variance` findings will be cleaned up on the next scan. No code changes needed for this issue.

**If the duplicate detection code still exists in working tree** (per user's report): Need to verify by checking `git stash` or the committed version. The user's description says "Both `phase_signature()` (shared) and `phase_smells()` (TS and Python) call `detect_signature_variance()`." If this is about the committed code on `main` (not the WIP branch), then:

- **Keep** it only in `phase_signature()` in `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/languages/_framework/base/shared_phases.py`.

1. **Fix 1 (orphaned findings)** -- Independent. Do this first because it eliminates the data-layer problem.

3. **Fix 3 interacts with plan reconciliation** (`_reconcile_plan_post_scan` in scan_workflow.py). The reconciliation injects stale dimensions and calls `compute_subjective_visibility` -- make sure the new parameters are threaded through.

   342→            scores[alias] = strict_val
   343→    return scores
   344→
   345→
   346→def build_subjective_items(
   347→    state: dict, findings: dict, *, threshold: float = 100.0
   348→) -> list[dict]:
   349→    """Create synthetic subjective work items."""
   350→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
   351→    if not dim_scores:
   352→        return []
   353→    threshold = max(0.0, min(100.0, float(threshold)))
   354→
   355→    subjective_entries = all_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores)
   356→    if not subjective_entries:
   357→        return []
   358→    unassessed_dims = {
   359→        str(name).strip()
   360→        for name in unassessed_subjective_dimensions(
   361→            dim_scores
   362→        )
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    # Review findings are keyed by raw dimension name (snake_case).
   366→    review_open_by_dim: dict[str, int] = {}
   367→    for finding in findings.values():
   368→        if finding.get("status") != "open" or finding.get("detector") != "review":
   369→            continue
   370→        dim_key = str(detail_dict(finding).get("dimension", "")).strip().lower()
   371→        if not dim_key:
   372→            continue
   373→        review_open_by_dim[dim_key] = review_open_by_dim.get(dim_key, 0) + 1
   374→
   375→    items: list[dict] = []
   376→    def _prepare_command(
   377→        cli_keys: list[str],
   378→        *,
   379→        force_review_rerun: bool = False,
   380→    ) -> str:
   381→        command = "desloppify review --prepare"
   382→        if cli_keys:
   383→            command += " --dimensions " + ",".join(cli_keys)
   384→        if force_review_rerun:
   385→            command += " --force-review-rerun"
   386→        return command
   387→
   388→    for entry in subjective_entries:
   389→        name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
   390→        if not name:
   391→            continue
   392→        strict_val = float(entry.get("strict", entry.get("score", 100.0)))
   393→        if strict_val >= threshold:
   394→            continue
   395→
   396→        [REDACTED](name)
   397→        aliases = set(_subjective_dimension_aliases(name))
   398→        cli_keys = [
   399→            str(key).strip().lower()
   400→            for key in entry.get("cli_keys", [])
   401→            if str(key).strip()
   402→        ]
   403→        aliases.update(cli_keys)
   404→        aliases.update(slugify(key) for key in cli_keys)
   405→        open_review = sum(review_open_by_dim.get(alias, 0) for alias in aliases)
   406→        is_unassessed = bool(entry.get("placeholder")) or (
   407→            name in unassessed_dims
   408→            or (strict_val <= 0.0 and int(entry.get("issues", 0)) == 0)
   409→        )
   410→        is_stale = bool(entry.get("stale"))
   411→        # If review findings already exist for this dimension, triage/fix them
   412→        # before suggesting another review refresh pass.
   413→        if open_review > 0:
   414→            primary_command = "desloppify show review --status open"
   415→        else:
   416→            primary_command = _prepare_command(cli_keys)
   417→        stale_tag = " [stale — re-review]" if is_stale else ""
   418→        summary = f"Subjective dimension below target: {name} ({strict_val:.1f}%){stale_tag}"
   419→        items.append(
   420→            {
   421→                "id": f"subjective::{slugify(dim_key)}",
   422→                "detector": "subjective_assessment",
   423→                "file": ".",
   424→                "confidence": "medium",
   425→                "summary": summary,
   426→                "detail": {
   427→                    "dimension_name": name,
   428→                    "dimension": dim_key,
   429→                    "issues": int(entry.get("issues", 0)),
   430→                    "strict_score": strict_val,
   431→                    "open_review_findings": open_review,
   432→                    "cli_keys": cli_keys,
   433→                },
   434→                "status": "open",
   435→                "kind": "subjective_dimension",
   436→                "primary_command": primary_command,
   437→                "initial_review": is_unassessed,
   438→                "stale_review": is_stale and not is_unassessed,
   439→            }
   440→        )
   441→    return items
   442→
   443→
   444→__all__ = [
   445→    "ALL_STATUSES",
   446→    "ATTEST_EXAMPLE",
   447→    "build_create_plan_item",
   448→    "build_score_checkpoint_item",
   449→    "build_subjective_items",

   404→    if queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is not None and breakdown is not None:
   405→        frozen = plan_start_strict
   406→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown, frozen_score=frozen)
   407→        print()
   408→        for text, style in block:

   410→        print(colorize(

   414→    elif queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is not None:
   415→        print(

   418→                "cyan",

   420→        )
   421→        print(

   423→                f"  Queue: {queue_total} item{'s' if queue_total != 1 else ''}"
   424→                " remaining. Score will not update until the queue is clear and you run `desloppify scan`.",
   425→                "dim",
   426→            )
   427→        )
   428→    elif strict_score is not None:
   429→        gap = round(float(target_strict_score) - float(strict_score), 1)
   430→        if gap > 0:
   431→            print(

   437→        else:

   444→    # Show queue block after north star when no frozen score
   445→    if breakdown is not None and queue_total > 0 and plan_start_strict is None:
   446→        block = format_queue_block(breakdown)
   447→        for text, style in block:
   448→            print(colorize(text, style))
   449→
   450→    # Subjective bottleneck banner — only shown when the objective queue is
   451→    # clear.  While objective items remain, the queue is the single authority
   452→    # on what to work on next; no need to distract with subjective advice.
   453→    _objective_remaining = max(
   454→        0,

   456→    )
   457→    if strict_score is not None and dim_scores and _objective_remaining <= 0:
   458→        try:
   459→            health_breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dim_scores)
   460→            subjective_drag = sum(

   465→            mechanical_drag = sum(

   467→                for e in health_breakdown.get("entries", [])

   469→            )
   470→            if subjective_drag > mechanical_drag and subjective_drag > 5.0:
   471→                print(colorize(

   476→                print(colorize(

   482→        except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:

   484→

   487→        print(colorize(f"\n  {message}", style))
   488→
   489→    # Rescan nudge after structural work

   493→            "let cascade effects settle: `desloppify scan --path .`",

   496→
   497→    # Collapsed subjective summary.
   498→    coverage_open, _coverage_reasons, _holistic_reasons = subjective_coverage_breakdown(
   499→        findings_scoped

   501→    parts: list[str] = []

   504→    stale_count = sum(1 for e in subjective_entries if e.get("stale"))

1→"""Unified work-queue selection for next/show/plan views."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from dataclasses import dataclass
     6→from typing import TypedDict
     7→
     8→from desloppify.engine._plan.subjective_policy import (
     9→    SubjectiveVisibility,
    10→    compute_subjective_visibility,
    11→)
    12→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import (
    13→    ALL_STATUSES,
    14→    ATTEST_EXAMPLE,
    15→    build_create_plan_item,
    16→    build_score_checkpoint_item,
    17→    build_subjective_items,
    18→    build_triage_stage_items,
    19→    scope_matches,
    20→)
    21→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.ranking import (
    22→    build_finding_items,
    23→    enrich_with_impact,
    24→    group_queue_items,
    25→    item_explain,
    26→    item_sort_key,
    27→)
    28→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.plan_order import (
    29→    apply_plan_order as _apply_plan_order,
    30→    collapse_clusters as _collapse_clusters,
    31→    new_item_ids as _new_item_ids,
    32→)
    33→from desloppify.state import StateModel
    34→
    35→
    36→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    37→class QueueBuildOptions:
    38→    """Configuration for queue construction."""
    39→
    40→    count: int | None = 1
    41→    scan_path: str | None = None
    42→    scope: str | None = None
    43→    status: str = "open"
    44→    include_subjective: bool = True
    45→    subjective_threshold: float = 100.0
    46→    chronic: bool = False
    47→    explain: bool = False
    48→    plan: dict | None = None
    49→    include_skipped: bool = False
    50→    cluster: str | None = None
    51→    collapse_clusters: bool = True
    52→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None
    53→
    54→
    55→class WorkQueueResult(TypedDict):
    56→    """Typed shape of the dict returned by :func:`build_work_queue`."""
    57→
    58→    items: list[dict]
    59→    total: int
    60→    grouped: dict[str, list[dict]]
    61→    new_ids: set[str]
    62→
    63→
    64→def build_work_queue(
    65→    state: StateModel,
    66→    *,
    67→    options: QueueBuildOptions | None = None,
    68→) -> WorkQueueResult:
    69→    """Build ranked queue items + tier metadata."""
    70→    resolved_options = options or QueueBuildOptions()
    71→
    72→    status = resolved_options.status
    73→    if status not in ALL_STATUSES:
    74→        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported status filter: {status}")
    75→    try:
    76→        subjective_threshold_value = float(resolved_options.subjective_threshold)
    77→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
    78→        subjective_threshold_value = 100.0
    79→    subjective_threshold_value = max(0.0, min(100.0, subjective_threshold_value))
    80→
    81→    finding_items = build_finding_items(
    82→        state,
    83→        scan_path=resolved_options.scan_path,
    84→        status_filter=status,
    85→        scope=resolved_options.scope,
    86→        chronic=resolved_options.chronic,
    87→    )
    88→
    89→    all_items = list(finding_items)
    90→
    91→    # Resolve subjective visibility policy for gating
    92→    policy = resolved_options.policy or compute_subjective_visibility(state)
    93→
    94→    if (
    95→        resolved_options.include_subjective
    96→        and status in {"open", "all"}
    97→        and not resolved_options.chronic
    98→    ):
    99→        subjective_items = build_subjective_items(
   100→            state,
   101→            state.get("findings", {}),
   102→            threshold=subjective_threshold_value,
   103→        )
   104→        # When a plan explicitly includes a subjective item in queue_order,
   105→        # surface it regardless of policy — the plan is authoritative.
   106→        plan_queue_set: set[str] = (
   107→            set(resolved_options.plan.get("queue_order", []))
   108→            if resolved_options.plan
   109→            else set()
   110→        )
   111→        for item in subjective_items:
   112→            if not scope_matches(item, resolved_options.scope):
   113→                continue
   114→            # Non-initial subjective items only surface when objective
   115→            # backlog is drained — unless the plan explicitly queued them
   116→            # (e.g. stale dims injected after a completed cycle).
   117→            item_id = item.get("id", "")
   118→            if not policy.should_surface(item) and item_id not in plan_queue_set:
   119→                continue
   120→            all_items.append(item)
   121→
   122→    # Inject triage stage items and workflow items when plan requires it
   123→    if resolved_options.plan and status in {"open", "all"}:
   124→        synth_items = build_triage_stage_items(resolved_options.plan, state)
   125→        all_items.extend(synth_items)
   126→        checkpoint_item = build_score_checkpoint_item(resolved_options.plan, state)
   127→        if checkpoint_item is not None:
   128→            all_items.append(checkpoint_item)
   129→        plan_item = build_create_plan_item(resolved_options.plan)
   130→        if plan_item is not None:
   131→            all_items.append(plan_item)
   132→
   133→    enrich_with_impact(all_items, state.get("dimension_scores", {}))
   134→
   135→    # Impact floor: drop mechanical findings with negligible score impact
   136→    MIN_STANDALONE_IMPACT = 0.05
   137→    all_items = [
   138→        item for item in all_items
   139→        if item.get("kind") != "finding"
   140→        or item.get("is_review")
   141→        or item.get("is_subjective")
   142→        or not item.get("estimated_impact")
   143→        or item["estimated_impact"] >= MIN_STANDALONE_IMPACT
   144→    ]
   145→
   146→    all_items.sort(key=item_sort_key)
   147→
   148→    # Apply living plan ordering if provided
   149→    new_ids: set[str] = set()
   150→    if resolved_options.plan:
   151→        new_ids = _new_item_ids(state)
   152→        all_items = _apply_plan_order(
   153→            all_items,
   154→            resolved_options.plan,
   155→            include_skipped=resolved_options.include_skipped,
   156→            cluster=resolved_options.cluster,
   157→            new_ids=new_ids,
   158→        )
   159→
   160→    # Collapse auto-clusters into meta-items (unless drilling into a cluster)
   161→    should_collapse = (
   162→        resolved_options.collapse_clusters
   163→        and resolved_options.plan
   164→        and not resolved_options.cluster
   165→        and not resolved_options.plan.get("active_cluster")
   166→    )
   167→    if should_collapse:
   168→        all_items = _collapse_clusters(all_items, resolved_options.plan)
   169→
   170→    total = len(all_items)
   171→    if resolved_options.count is not None and resolved_options.count > 0:
   172→        all_items = all_items[: resolved_options.count]
   173→
   174→    if resolved_options.explain:
   175→        for item in all_items:
   176→            item["explain"] = item_explain(item)
   177→
   178→    return {
   179→        "items": all_items,
   180→        "total": total,
   181→        "grouped": group_queue_items(all_items, "item"),
   182→        "new_ids": new_ids,
   183→    }
   184→
   185→
   186→__all__ = [
   187→    "ATTEST_EXAMPLE",
   188→    "QueueBuildOptions",
   189→    "WorkQueueResult",
   190→    "build_work_queue",
   191→    "group_queue_items",
   192→]
   193→

1→"""Sync subjective dimensions into the plan queue.
     2→
     3→Two independent sync functions:
     4→
     5→- **sync_unscored_dimensions** — prepend never-scored (placeholder) dimensions
     6→  to the *front* of the queue unconditionally (onboarding priority).
     7→- **sync_stale_dimensions** — append stale (previously-scored) dimensions to
     8→  the *back* of the queue when no objective items remain.
     9→"""
    10→
    11→from __future__ import annotations
    12→
    13→import hashlib
    14→from dataclasses import dataclass, field
    15→
    16→from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import PlanModel, ensure_plan_defaults
    17→from desloppify.engine._plan.subjective_policy import (
    18→    NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS,
    19→    SubjectiveVisibility,
    20→)
    21→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel
    22→
    23→SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX = "subjective::"
    24→TRIAGE_ID = "triage::pending"  # deprecated, kept for migration
    25→
    26→TRIAGE_PREFIX = "triage::"
    27→TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS = (
    28→    "triage::observe",
    29→    "triage::reflect",
    30→    "triage::organize",
    31→    "triage::commit",
    32→)
    33→TRIAGE_IDS = set(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS)
    34→WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID = "workflow::create-plan"
    35→WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID = "workflow::score-checkpoint"
    36→WORKFLOW_PREFIX = "workflow::"
    37→SYNTHETIC_PREFIXES = ("triage::", "workflow::", "subjective::")
    38→
    39→
    40→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    41→# Result dataclasses
    42→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    43→
    44→@dataclass
    45→class StaleDimensionSyncResult:
    46→    """What changed during a stale-dimension sync."""
    47→
    48→    injected: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    49→    pruned: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    50→
    51→    @property
    52→    def changes(self) -> int:
    53→        return len(self.injected) + len(self.pruned)
    54→
    55→
    56→@dataclass
    57→class UnscoredDimensionSyncResult:
    58→    """What changed during an unscored-dimension sync."""
    59→
    60→    injected: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    61→    pruned: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    62→
    63→    @property
    64→    def changes(self) -> int:
    65→        return len(self.injected) + len(self.pruned)
    66→
    67→
    68→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    69→# ID helpers
    70→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    71→
    72→def _current_stale_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
    73→    """Return the set of ``subjective::<slug>`` IDs that are currently stale."""
    74→    from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import slugify
    75→    from desloppify.engine.planning.scorecard_projection import (
    76→        all_subjective_entries,
    77→    )
    78→
    79→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
    80→    if not dim_scores:
    81→        return set()
    82→
    83→    stale: set[str] = set()
    84→    for entry in all_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores):
    85→        if not entry.get("stale"):
    86→            continue
    87→        dim_key = entry.get("dimension_key", "")
    88→        if dim_key:
    89→            stale.add(f"{SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX}{slugify(dim_key)}")
    90→    return stale
    91→
    92→
    93→def current_unscored_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
    94→    """Return the set of ``subjective::<slug>`` IDs that are currently unscored (placeholder).
    95→
    96→    Checks ``subjective_assessments`` first; when that dict is empty
    97→    (common before any reviews have been run), falls through to
    98→    ``dimension_scores`` which carries placeholder metadata from scan.
    99→    """
   100→    from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import slugify
   101→
   102→    # Primary source: subjective_assessments with placeholder=True
   103→    assessments = state.get("subjective_assessments")
   104→    if isinstance(assessments, dict) and assessments:
   105→        unscored: set[str] = set()
   106→        for dim_key, payload in assessments.items():
   107→            if not isinstance(payload, dict):
   108→                continue
   109→            if not payload.get("placeholder"):
   110→                continue
   111→            if dim_key:
   112→                unscored.add(f"{SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX}{slugify(dim_key)}")
   113→        return unscored
   114→
   115→    # Fallback: check dimension_scores directly for placeholder subjective
   116→    # dimensions.  This handles the common case where subjective_assessments
   117→    # hasn't been populated yet but dimension_scores already has placeholder
   118→    # entries from scan.  We can't use scorecard_subjective_entries() here
   119→    # because the scorecard pipeline intentionally hides placeholders.
   120→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
   121→    if not dim_scores:
   122→        return set()
   123→
   124→    unscored = set()
   125→    for _name, data in dim_scores.items():
   126→        if not isinstance(data, dict):
   127→            continue
   128→        detectors = data.get("detectors", {})
   129→        meta = detectors.get("subjective_assessment")
   130→        if not isinstance(meta, dict):
   131→            continue
   132→        if not meta.get("placeholder"):
   133→            continue
   134→        dim_key = meta.get("dimension_key", "")
   135→        if dim_key:
   136→            unscored.add(f"{SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX}{slugify(dim_key)}")
   137→    return unscored
   138→
   139→
   140→def current_under_target_ids(
   141→    state: StateModel,
   142→    *,
   143→    target_strict: float = 95.0,
   144→) -> set[str]:
   145→    """Return ``subjective::<slug>`` IDs that are under target but not stale or unscored.
   146→
   147→    These are dimensions whose assessment is still current (not needing refresh)
   148→    but whose score hasn't reached the target yet.
   149→    """
   150→    from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import slugify
   151→    from desloppify.engine.planning.scorecard_projection import (
   152→        all_subjective_entries,
   153→    )
   154→
   155→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
   156→    if not dim_scores:
   157→        return set()
   158→
   159→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   160→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   161→
   162→    under_target: set[str] = set()
   163→    for entry in all_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores):
   164→        if entry.get("placeholder") or entry.get("stale"):
   165→            continue
   166→        strict_val = float(entry.get("strict", entry.get("score", 100.0)))
   167→        if strict_val >= target_strict:
   168→            continue
   169→        dim_key = entry.get("dimension_key", "")
   170→        if not dim_key:
   171→            continue
   172→        fid = f"{SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX}{slugify(dim_key)}"
   173→        if fid not in stale_ids and fid not in unscored_ids:
   174→            under_target.add(fid)
   175→    return under_target
   176→
   177→
   178→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   179→# Promoted-aware insertion helper
   180→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   181→
   182→def _after_promoted(order: list[str], plan: PlanModel) -> int:
   183→    """Return the insertion index just after the last promoted item in *order*.
   184→
   185→    When no promoted items are present (or none are in *order*), returns 0
   186→    so callers fall back to existing front-of-queue behavior.
   187→    """
   188→    promoted = set(plan.get("promoted_ids", []))
   189→    if not promoted:
   190→        return 0
   191→    last_idx = -1
   192→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   193→        if fid in promoted:
   194→            last_idx = i
   195→    return last_idx + 1 if last_idx >= 0 else 0
   196→
   197→
   198→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   199→# Unscored dimension sync (front of queue, unconditional)
   200→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   201→
   202→def sync_unscored_dimensions(
   203→    plan: PlanModel,
   204→    state: StateModel,
   205→) -> UnscoredDimensionSyncResult:
   206→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions.
   207→
   208→    1. **Prune** — remove ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are
   209→       no longer unscored AND not stale (avoids pruning stale IDs — that is
   210→       ``sync_stale_dimensions``' responsibility).
   211→    2. **Inject** — unconditionally prepend currently-unscored IDs to the
   212→       *front* of ``queue_order`` so initial reviews are the first priority.
   213→    """
   214→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   215→    result = UnscoredDimensionSyncResult()
   216→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   217→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   218→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   219→
   220→    # --- Cleanup: prune subjective IDs that are no longer unscored --------
   221→    # Only prune IDs that are neither unscored nor stale (stale sync owns those).
   222→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   223→        fid for fid in order
   224→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   225→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   226→        and fid not in stale_ids
   227→    ]
   228→    for fid in to_remove:
   229→        order.remove(fid)
   230→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   231→
   232→    # --- Inject: prepend unscored IDs after any promoted items -------------
   233→    existing = set(order)
   234→    insert_at = _after_promoted(order, plan)
   235→    for uid in reversed(sorted(unscored_ids)):
   236→        if uid not in existing:
   237→            order.insert(insert_at, uid)
   238→            result.injected.append(uid)
   239→
   240→    return result
   241→
   242→
   243→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   244→# Stale dimension sync (back of queue, conditional)
   245→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   246→
   247→def sync_stale_dimensions(
   248→    plan: PlanModel,
   249→    state: StateModel,
   250→    *,
   251→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   252→    cycle_just_completed: bool = False,
   253→) -> StaleDimensionSyncResult:
   254→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with stale and under-target subjective dimensions.
   255→
   256→    1. Remove any ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are no
   257→       longer stale/under-target and not unscored (avoids pruning IDs owned
   258→       by ``sync_unscored_dimensions``).
   259→    2. Inject stale and under-target dimension IDs when either:
   260→       a. No objective items remain (mid-cycle: append to back), OR
   261→       b. A cycle just completed (post-cycle: insert at front so subjective
   262→          review takes priority over new objective findings).
   263→    """
   264→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   265→    result = StaleDimensionSyncResult()
   266→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   267→    under_target_ids = current_under_target_ids(state)
   268→    injectable_ids = stale_ids | under_target_ids
   269→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   270→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   271→
   272→    # --- Cleanup: prune resolved subjective IDs --------------------------
   273→    # Only prune IDs that are no longer injectable and not unscored.
   274→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   275→        fid for fid in order
   276→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   277→        and fid not in injectable_ids
   278→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   279→    ]
   280→    for fid in to_remove:
   281→        order.remove(fid)
   282→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   283→
   284→    # --- Inject or evict stale + under-target dimensions -----------------
   285→    if policy is not None:
   286→        has_real_items = policy.has_objective_backlog
   287→    else:
   288→        has_real_items = any(
   289→            f.get("status") == "open"
   290→            and f.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   291→            and not f.get("suppressed")
   292→            for f in state.get("findings", {}).values()
   293→        )
   294→
   295→    should_inject = not has_real_items or cycle_just_completed
   296→
   297→    if not should_inject:
   298→        # Mid-cycle with objective backlog: evict any stale/under-target IDs
   299→        # that are present in the queue.  They may have been grandfathered from
   300→        # the unscored phase and should not be visible until the objective
   301→        # backlog clears or a cycle completes.
   302→        to_evict = [
   303→            fid for fid in order
   304→            if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   305→            and fid in injectable_ids
   306→        ]
   307→        for fid in to_evict:
   308→            order.remove(fid)
   309→            result.pruned.append(fid)
   310→
   311→    if should_inject and injectable_ids:
   312→        existing = set(order)
   313→        if cycle_just_completed and has_real_items:
   314→            # Post-cycle: front-of-queue after promoted items so subjective
   315→            # review happens before the new objective cycle begins.
   316→            insert_at = _after_promoted(order, plan)
   317→            for sid in reversed(sorted(injectable_ids)):
   318→                if sid not in existing:
   319→                    order.insert(insert_at, sid)
   320→                    result.injected.append(sid)
   321→        else:
   322→            # Mid-cycle or no objective backlog: append to back.
   323→            for sid in sorted(injectable_ids):
   324→                if sid not in existing:
   325→                    order.append(sid)
   326→                    result.injected.append(sid)
   327→
   328→    return result
   329→
   330→
   331→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   332→# Triage snapshot hash + sync
   333→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   334→
   335→def review_finding_snapshot_hash(state: StateModel) -> str:
   336→    """Hash open review finding IDs to detect changes.
   337→
   338→    Returns empty string when there are no open review findings.
   339→    """
   340→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   341→    review_ids = sorted(
   342→        fid for fid, f in findings.items()
   343→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   344→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   345→    )
   346→    if not review_ids:
   347→        return ""
   348→    return hashlib.sha256("|".join(review_ids).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
   349→
   350→
   351→@dataclass
   352→class TriageSyncResult:
   353→    """What changed during a triage sync."""
   354→
   355→    injected: bool = False
   356→    pruned: bool = False
   357→
   358→    @property
   359→    def changes(self) -> int:
   360→        return int(self.injected) + int(self.pruned)
   361→
   362→
   363→def sync_triage_needed(
   364→    plan: PlanModel,
   365→    state: StateModel,
   366→) -> TriageSyncResult:
   367→    """Inject 4 triage stage IDs at front of queue when review findings change.
   368→
   369→    Only injects stages not already confirmed in ``epic_triage_meta``.
   370→    Never auto-prunes — only explicit completion removes them.
   371→
   372→    When findings are *resolved* (current IDs are a subset of previously
   373→    triaged IDs), the snapshot hash is updated silently — no re-triage
   374→    is needed since the user is working through the plan.
   375→    """
   376→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   377→    result = TriageSyncResult()
   378→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   379→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   380→    confirmed = set(meta.get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   381→
   382→    # Check if any triage stage is already in queue
   383→    already_present = any(sid in order for sid in TRIAGE_IDS)
   384→
   385→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   386→    last_hash = meta.get("finding_snapshot_hash", "")
   387→
   388→    if current_hash and current_hash != last_hash and not already_present:
   389→        # Distinguish "new findings appeared" from "findings were resolved".
   390→        # Only re-triage when genuinely new findings exist.
   391→        findings = state.get("findings", {})
   392→        current_review_ids = {
   393→            fid for fid, f in findings.items()
   394→            if f.get("status") == "open"
   395→            and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   396→        }
   397→        triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   398→        new_since_triage = current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   399→
   400→        if new_since_triage:
   401→            # New review findings appeared — re-triage needed
   402→            insert_at = _after_promoted(order, plan)
   403→            stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   404→            existing = set(order)
   405→            injected_count = 0
   406→            for sid, name in zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names):
   407→                if name not in confirmed and sid not in existing:
   408→                    order.insert(insert_at + injected_count, sid)
   409→                    injected_count += 1
   410→            if injected_count:
   411→                result.injected = True
   412→        else:
   413→            # Only resolved findings changed the hash — update silently
   414→            meta["finding_snapshot_hash"] = current_hash
   415→            plan["epic_triage_meta"] = meta
   416→
   417→    return result
   418→
   419→
   420→@dataclass
   421→class ScoreCheckpointSyncResult:
   422→    """What changed during a score-checkpoint sync."""
   423→
   424→    injected: bool = False
   425→
   426→    @property
   427→    def changes(self) -> int:
   428→        return int(self.injected)
   429→
   430→
   431→def sync_score_checkpoint_needed(
   432→    plan: PlanModel,
   433→    state: StateModel,
   434→    *,
   435→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   436→) -> ScoreCheckpointSyncResult:
   437→    """Inject ``workflow::score-checkpoint`` when all initial reviews complete.
   438→
   439→    Injects when:
   440→    - No unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions remain
   441→    - ``workflow::score-checkpoint`` is not already in the queue
   442→
   443→    Positioned after subjective items but before triage/create-plan
   444→    so the user sees their updated strict score right after reviews finish.
   445→    """
   446→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   447→    result = ScoreCheckpointSyncResult()
   448→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   449→
   450→    if WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID in order:
   451→        return result
   452→
   453→    # Check that no unscored dimensions remain
   454→    if policy is not None:
   455→        if policy.unscored_ids:
   456→            return result
   457→    else:
   458→        unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   459→        if unscored:
   460→            return result
   461→
   462→    # Insert after any subjective items, before triage/workflow/findings
   463→    insert_at = 0
   464→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   465→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX):
   466→            insert_at = i + 1
   467→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID)
   468→    result.injected = True
   469→    return result
   470→
   471→
   472→@dataclass
   473→class CreatePlanSyncResult:
   474→    """What changed during a create-plan sync."""
   475→
   476→    injected: bool = False
   477→
   478→    @property
   479→    def changes(self) -> int:
   480→        return int(self.injected)
   481→
   482→
   483→def sync_create_plan_needed(
   484→    plan: PlanModel,
   485→    state: StateModel,
   486→    *,
   487→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   488→) -> CreatePlanSyncResult:
   489→    """Inject ``workflow::create-plan`` when reviews complete + objective backlog exists.
   490→
   491→    Only injects when:
   492→    - No unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions remain
   493→    - At least one objective finding exists
   494→    - ``workflow::create-plan`` is not already in the queue
   495→    - No triage stages are pending
   496→    """
   497→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   498→    result = CreatePlanSyncResult()
   499→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   500→
   501→    if WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID in order:
   502→        return result
   503→
   504→    # Don't inject if triage stages are pending
   505→    if any(sid in order for sid in TRIAGE_IDS):
   506→        return result
   507→
   508→    # Check that no unscored dimensions remain
   509→    if policy is not None:
   510→        if policy.unscored_ids:
   511→            return result
   512→        has_objective = policy.has_objective_backlog
   513→    else:
   514→        unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   515→        if unscored:
   516→            return result
   517→        findings = state.get("findings", {})
   518→        has_objective = any(
   519→            f.get("status") == "open"
   520→            and f.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   521→            for f in findings.values()
   522→        )
   523→    if not has_objective:
   524→        return result
   525→
   526→    # Insert after any subjective/workflow items, at the end of the
   527→    # synthetic block (so create-plan comes after score-checkpoint).
   528→    insert_at = 0
   529→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   530→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(TRIAGE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(WORKFLOW_PREFIX):
   531→            insert_at = i + 1
   532→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID)
   533→    result.injected = True
   534→    return result
   535→
   536→
   537→def compute_new_finding_ids(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
   538→    """Return the set of open review/concerns finding IDs added since last triage.
   539→
   540→    Returns an empty set when no prior triage has recorded ``triaged_ids``.
   541→    """
   542→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   543→    triaged = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", meta.get("synthesized_ids", [])))
   544→    current = {
   545→        fid for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
   546→        if f.get("status") == "open" and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   547→    }
   548→    return current - triaged if triaged else set()
   549→
   550→
   551→def is_triage_stale(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> bool:
   552→    """Side-effect-free check: is triage needed?
   553→
   554→    Returns True when any ``triage::*`` stage ID is in the queue OR
   555→    genuinely *new* review findings appeared since the last triage.
   556→
   557→    When findings are merely resolved (current IDs are a subset of
   558→    previously triaged IDs), triage is NOT stale — the user is working
   559→    through the plan.
   560→    """
   561→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   562→    order = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   563→    if order & TRIAGE_IDS:
   564→        return True
   565→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   566→    last_hash = meta.get("finding_snapshot_hash", "")
   567→    if not last_hash:
   568→        return False
   569→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   570→    if not current_hash or current_hash == last_hash:
   571→        return False
   572→    # Hash changed — check if new findings appeared or only resolutions
   573→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   574→    current_review_ids = {
   575→        fid for fid, f in findings.items()
   576→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   577→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   578→    }
   579→    triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   580→    new_since_triage = current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   581→    return bool(new_since_triage)
   582→
   583→
   584→
   585→__all__ = [
   586→    "NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS",
   587→    "SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX",
   588→    "TRIAGE_ID",
   589→    "TRIAGE_IDS",
   590→    "TRIAGE_PREFIX",
   591→    "TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS",
   592→    "SYNTHETIC_PREFIXES",
   593→    "WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID",
   594→    "WORKFLOW_PREFIX",
   595→    "WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID",
   596→    "CreatePlanSyncResult",
   597→    "ScoreCheckpointSyncResult",
   598→    "StaleDimensionSyncResult",
   599→    "TriageSyncResult",
   600→    "UnscoredDimensionSyncResult",
   601→    "current_under_target_ids",
   602→    "current_unscored_ids",
   603→    "compute_new_finding_ids",
   604→    "is_triage_stale",
   605→    "review_finding_snapshot_hash",
   606→    "sync_create_plan_needed",
   607→    "sync_score_checkpoint_needed",
   608→    "sync_stale_dimensions",
   609→    "sync_triage_needed",
   610→    "sync_unscored_dimensions",
   611→]

    69→    if item.get("is_blocked"):
    70→        serialized["is_blocked"] = True
    71→
    72→    explain = item.get("explain")
    73→    if explain is not None:
    74→        serialized["explain"] = explain
    75→
    76→    # Plan metadata
    77→    if item.get("queue_position"):
    78→        serialized["queue_position"] = item["queue_position"]
    79→    if item.get("plan_description"):
    80→        serialized["plan_description"] = item["plan_description"]
    81→    if item.get("plan_note"):
    82→        serialized["plan_note"] = item["plan_note"]
    83→    if item.get("plan_cluster"):
    84→        serialized["plan_cluster"] = item["plan_cluster"]
    85→    if item.get("plan_skipped"):
    86→        serialized["plan_skipped"] = True
    87→        serialized["plan_skip_kind"] = item.get("plan_skip_kind", "temporary")
    88→        if item.get("plan_skip_reason"):
    89→            serialized["plan_skip_reason"] = item["plan_skip_reason"]
    90→
    91→    return serialized
    92→
    93→
    94→def build_query_payload(
    95→    queue: Mapping[str, Any],
    96→    items: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
    97→    *,
    98→    command: str,
    99→    narrative: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
   100→    plan: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
   101→) -> dict[str, Any]:
   102→    """Build JSON payload for query.json and non-terminal output modes."""
   103→    serialized = [serialize_item(item) for item in items]
   104→    queue_section: dict[str, Any] = {
   105→        "total": queue.get("total", len(items)),
   106→    }
   107→
   108→    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
   109→        "command": command,
   110→        "items": serialized,
   111→        "queue": queue_section,
   112→        "narrative": narrative,
   113→    }
   114→
   115→    if plan and (
   116→        plan.get("queue_order")
   117→        or plan.get("skipped")
   118→        or plan.get("clusters")
   119→    ):
   120→        clusters_summary = []
   121→        for name, cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).items():
   122→            member_ids = set(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
   123→            clusters_summary.append({
   124→                "name": name,
   125→                "description": cluster.get("description"),
   126→                "item_count": len(member_ids),
   127→            })
   128→        payload["plan"] = {
   129→            "active": True,
   130→            "focus": plan.get("active_cluster"),
   131→            "clusters": clusters_summary,
   132→            "total_ordered": len(plan.get("queue_order", [])),
   133→            "total_skipped": len(plan.get("skipped", {})),
   134→            "plan_overrides_narrative": True,
   135→        }
   136→
   137→    return payload
   138→
   139→
   140→def render_markdown(items: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> str:
   141→    """Render queue items as markdown."""
   142→    lines = [
   143→        "# Desloppify Next Queue",
   144→        "",
   145→        "| Kind | Confidence | Summary | Command |",
   146→        "|------|------------|---------|---------|",
   147→    ]
   148→    for item in items:
   149→        kind = item.get("kind", "finding")
   150→        conf = item.get("confidence", "medium")
   151→        summary = item.get("summary", "").replace("|", "\\|")
   152→        command = (item.get("primary_command", "") or "").replace("|", "\\|")
   153→        lines.append(f"| {kind} | {conf} | {summary} | {command} |")
   154→    lines.append("")
   155→    return "\n".join(lines)
   156→
   157→
   158→def write_output_file(
   159→    output_file: str,
   160→    payload: dict[str, Any],
   161→    item_count: int,
   162→    *,
   163→    safe_write_text_fn,
   164→    colorize_fn,
   165→) -> bool:
   166→    """Persist payload to file and print success/failure hints."""
   167→    try:
   168→        safe_write_text_fn(output_file, json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n")
   169→        print(colorize_fn(f"Wrote {item_count} items to {output_file}", "green"))
   170→    except OSError as exc:
   171→        payload["output_error"] = str(exc)
   172→        print_write_error(output_file, exc, label="next output")
   173→        return False
   174→    return True
   175→
   176→
   177→def emit_non_terminal_output(
   178→    output_format: str,
   179→    payload: dict[str, Any],
   180→    items: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
   181→) -> bool:
   182→    """Render JSON/markdown output variants."""
   183→    renderers = {
   184→        "json": lambda: print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2)),
   185→        "md": lambda: print(render_markdown(items)),
   186→    }
   187→    renderer = renderers.get(output_format)
   188→    if renderer is None:
   189→        return False
   190→    renderer()
   191→    return True
   192→
   193→
   194→__all__ = [
   195→    "build_query_payload",
   196→    "emit_non_terminal_output",
   197→    "render_markdown",
   198→    "serialize_item",
   199→    "write_output_file",
   200→]
   201→

     8→def new_item_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
     9→    """Return finding IDs added in the most recent scan."""
    10→    scan_history = state.get("scan_history", [])
    11→    if not scan_history:
    12→        return set()
    13→    threshold = scan_history[-1].get("timestamp", "")
    14→    if not threshold:
    15→        return set()
